channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Sep 08
item.description:
67 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Smart Alarm can now be placed on more deployables; bounds fixed and physics material assigned.
  • Cooking workbenches in snow no longer pause cooking when refrigerated items are inserted; refrigerated flag correctly transferred on splits.

Structures & Deployables

  • Smart Alarm can now be placed on more deployables; bounds fixed and physics material assigned.
  • New sandbag variations unlocked; original/BP button behavior fixed.
  • Seasonal decorations (wreaths, string lights) now deploy, pickup, and sound correctly, with proper placement guides.
  • Gates now open in the correct direction, have updated collision bounds, and proper socket checks for reliable placement.
  • Fence durability improved: debris removal and wood protection now applied instead of stone.
  • Prefab collision and collider setups corrected, fixing interaction bugs with structures and objects.

Crafting & Items

  • Cooking workbenches in snow no longer pause cooking when refrigerated items are inserted; refrigerated flag correctly transferred on splits.
  • Placeholder crafting costs adjusted to more sensible values.
  • Honey bandage added to primitive and hardcore tech trees, expanding medical crafting options.

NPC & AI

  • Frogs can now swim and more reliably seek water spots to croak.

Combat & Visuals

  • Third‑person arrows (including bow arrows) now correctly hide their mesh on the server, eliminating visual glitches.

Loot & Power

  • Ferry terminal loot room now functional and powered via the power grid.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Sep 07
item.description:
38 development commits

Animals & Livestock

  • Cows now have health tied to mood; unhappy cows die and health bar reflects condition.
  • Calf spawning fixed so newborn calves no longer get stuck behind walls and can escape pens.

Weapons & Attachments

  • Holosight rail visibility adjusted per weapon and 8x scope, handmade sight, and holosight attachments refreshed.
  • Holstered weapons repositioned to sit closer to chest armor for better alignment.

Building & UI

  • Placement guide rotations fixed, improving accuracy when rotating structures during building.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Train tunnel layouts are now randomized, changing navigation routes and loot placement in underground networks.

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed a save bug that unintentionally altered the Most Recently Used (MRU) list, preventing unexpected inventory changes on logout.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Sep 06
item.description:
7 development commits

UI & Quality of Life

  • Item pickup notices now display correctly without layout glitches.

Stability

  • Players will no longer be kicked for non‑critical errors on background threads.

Items & Equipment

  • Floating bandages bug fixed – bandages now rest on the ground as intended.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Prevent unintended player rank downgrades in the editor that previously failed to kick the player, ensuring proper enforcement of permission changes.
